svg.aria-label: Four ways of accenting the subject of a diagram, on a coloured subject and on an infrastructure subject
svg.text: How to accent the subject of a diagram
The accented box is the same throughout: “Readings bus” on the left, “node-2” on the right. Only the manner of accenting changes from one row to the next.
The two cases are not redundant: on the right the subject has to stand out from two twins of the same shape and the same layer. That is where the options diverge.
What is in place. Designates the subject and recalls
its layer in one gesture, with no extra colour.
But an infrastructure subject inherits the slate:
on the right, the accented node does not stand out.
Chosen. Works everywhere, whatever the layer.
Price: a seventh colour, which says nothing by
itself — the legend has to name it.
The 3.2 px stroke is not decorative: under
dichromacy this magenta is ΔE00 1.5 from “files”.
No new colour, and it works in every layer,
including on the twins on the right.
But the accent loses the hue when the subject has
one: on the left, the bus is no longer orange.
Keeps the hue when the subject has one, falls back
on weight otherwise. Both cases pass.
Cost: the accent becomes two variables, not one,
so one more fill in the scale of ADR 0007.
Chosen: 2, for its flexibility — it does not depend on the subject's layer. The thick stroke was added after measurement: alone, the magenta merges with the teal under dichromacy.
Only row 1 was in place in the repository at the time. Sheet generated by scripts/specimen-accent.mjs.
